about.heading: About Singhji Enterprises
about.body:
Singhji Enterprises is a wholesale and custom apparel manufacturer based in Mangaluru, Karnataka. We supply schools, sports clubs, corporates and institutions across India with uniforms and apparel built to last a full academic or working year.

Every order is handled from fabric selection through to final stitching, embroidery and delivery, so institutions get one dependable partner for their entire apparel requirement.
